parts.title: Part 1 · Dictation
parts.instr: Your teacher reads the dictation. Write what you hear in the box.

parts.title: Part 2 · Listening
parts.instr: Listen to your teacher’s questions. Choose the correct answer (a, b or c).

opts.a: trousers, a jacket and a waistcoat
opts.c: a shirt, a tie and a belt

parts.title: Part 3 · Gap fill
parts.instr: Write ONE word in each gap.

items.q: Come on, Mum! Dance with the rest of us. You need to ____ yourself go sometimes!
In my opinion, coffee tastes too ____ without sugar.
I ____ Shaun would stop singing and do something quieter!
We should ____ our kitchen knives regularly. They’re more dangerous when they’re blunt.
Following Roddy’s operation, it was a huge ____ when the doctor told us he was completely fine and recovering well.
Have you got a rubber I can use to rub ____ that last line?
Fernanda had no idea what to say. David’s question had taken her completely ____ surprise.
I’m quite envious ____ Joe’s ability to speak so easily in Spanish.
Robby grew to love being in the army, ____ all because it was exciting.
You are responsible ____ your own mistakes, Juan, nobody else.
I just told Tim to go and play in the garden; he was making a real nuisance ____ himself in the kitchen.
As a secondary school teacher in a tough part of the city, I have to be prepared to ____ my foot down at times.
The letter that’s ____ in the English alphabet is “y”.
Hugh’s tall, but only in relation ____ the rest of our family; we’re all pretty small.
If only Jake had ____ more effort at university. I think he regrets wasting his time there now.

parts.title: Part 5 · Error correction
parts.instr: Correct the mistake in each sentence. You can add one word, take out one word, or change one word. Type the whole corrected sentence.

items.text: The more you scratch an insect bite, the worse it itches, and the more frequent you’ll feel like you need to scratch it. So, stop scratching.
I didn’t want to come to Italy but, now than I’m here, I love it.
In addition for the local currency, this hotel will accept the euro and dollar for payments.
Don’t make attention to anything George says. He doesn’t know what he’s talking about.
After making an explanation of what had happened to the police officer, we were allowed to go home.
Getting a good degree would enable you planning your career with more freedom.
Jarmila set her 800m world record so long ago that many people now think it may never be taken.
Some people are capable for lying without feeling any guilt at all.
Don’t break your temper with Billy. He wasn’t trying to ruin the sofa; it was a science experiment.
I know it’s bad, but I can’t help to laugh. Dad’s such an awful cook.

parts.text: There are ninety degrees in a right angle. Another word for “hardly” is “scarcely”. A dog buries a bone in the ground. European people usually wear black for a funeral. The noun of the verb “admire” is “admiration”. We get water when ice melts. We call a man who works in a mine a miner. We shave with a razor. A voyage is a long journey on water or in space. Almost no crime has been reported in this town in the last year. It’s a complete mystery.

teacher.2: What do people usually say instead of “pence”?
teacher.3: What are the three forms of “forbid”?
teacher.5: What sort of things do people normally boast about?
teacher.8: What does a three-piece suit consist of?
teacher.10: What are the three forms of “dig”?
